INSERT INTO ez_shipping_cancel ( cd_item, nm_item, spec_item, kgm_weight, lbl_real_length, lbl_lot_no, no_mfg_order_serial, qty_inventory, wgt_inventory, cd_wh, nm_wh, lbl_date, nm_customer, po_customer, no_receipt, remarks, nm_location, invoice_no, invoice_name ) SELECT A.CD_ITEM, C.NM_ITEM, C.SPEC_ITEM, C.KGM_WEIGHT, FLOOR(ISNULL(A.LBL_REAL_LENGTH, 0)) AS lbl_real_length, A.LBL_LOT_NO, A.NO_MFG_ORDER_SERIAL, FLOOR(B.QTY_INVENTORY) AS qty_inventory, (ISNULL(B.QTY_INVENTORY, 0) * ISNULL(C.KGM_WEIGHT, 0) * ISNULL(A.LBL_REAL_LENGTH, 0)) / 1000 AS wgt_inventory, B.CD_WH, (SELECT NM_WH FROM B_WAREHOUSE WHERE CD_WH = B.CD_WH) AS nm_wh, A.LBL_DATE, A.NM_CUSTOMER, A.PO_CUSTOMER, A.NO_RECEIPT, A.REMARKS, A.NM_LOCATION, eiim.invoice_no, ein.invoice_name FROM M_WO_LABEL_DETAIL A WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN I_WH_ONHAND_INVENTORY B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.CD_ITEM = B.CD_ITEM AND A.LBL_LOT_NO = B.NO_LOT INNER JOIN B_ITEM C WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.CD_ITEM = C.CD_ITEM INNER JOIN ez_invoice_inventory_mapping eiim ON eiim.lot_no = A.LBL_LOT_NO INNER JOIN ez_invoice_name ein ON eiim.invoice_no = ein.invoice_no INNER JOIN ez_inventory_lot_ext AS eile ON A.LBL_LOT_NO = eile.ext_lot_no WHERE 1=1 AND B.QTY_INVENTORY != 0 AND B.CD_WH = 'YC_FG3' AND eiim.invoice_no IN

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'N' AS YN_CHECK , A.NM_CUSTOMER , A.CD_ITEM , C.NM_ITEM , C.SPEC_ITEM , C.KGM_WEIGHT , ISNULL(A.LBL_REAL_LENGTH, 0) AS LBL_REAL_LENGTH , A.LBL_LOT_NO , A.NO_MFG_ORDER_SERIAL , FLOOR(B.QTY_INVENTORY) AS QTY_INVENTORY , (ISNULL(B.QTY_INVENTORY,0) * ISNULL(C.KGM_WEIGHT,0) * ISNULL(A.LBL_REAL_LENGTH,0)) / 1000 AS WGT_INVENTORY , B.CD_WH , (SELECT TOP 1 NM_WH FROM B_WAREHOUSE WHERE CD_WH = B.CD_WH) AS NM_WH , A.LBL_DATE , A.PO_CUSTOMER , A.NO_RECEIPT , A.REMARKS , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.NM_CUSTOMER ORDER BY A.LBL_DATE DESC, A.LBL_LOT_NO DESC) AS RNUM FROM M_WO_LABEL_DETAIL A WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN I_WH_ONHAND_INVENTORY B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.CD_ITEM = B.CD_ITEM AND A.LBL_LOT_NO = B.NO_LOT INNER JOIN B_ITEM C WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.CD_ITEM = C.CD_ITEM WHERE B.QTY_INVENTORY != 0 AND A.NM_CUSTOMER != '' ) T WHERE T.RNUM = 1 -- 고객별 데이터 하나만 추출 ORDER BY T.NM_CUSTOMER ASC;

mapper.select:
SELECT -- [첫 번째 쿼리: 라벨 및 재고 정보] 'N' AS YN_CHECK , A.CD_ITEM , C.NM_ITEM , C.SPEC_ITEM , C.KGM_WEIGHT , FLOOR(ISNULL(A.LBL_REAL_LENGTH, 0)) AS LBL_REAL_LENGTH , A.LBL_LOT_NO , A.NO_MFG_ORDER_SERIAL , FLOOR(B.QTY_INVENTORY) AS qty_inventory , (ISNULL(B.QTY_INVENTORY,0) * ISNULL(C.KGM_WEIGHT,0) * ISNULL(A.LBL_REAL_LENGTH,0)) / 1000 AS WGT_INVENTORY , B.CD_WH , (SELECT NM_WH FROM B_WAREHOUSE WHERE CD_WH = B.CD_WH) AS NM_WH , A.LBL_DATE , A.NM_CUSTOMER , A.PO_CUSTOMER , A.NO_RECEIPT , A.REMARKS , eiim.invoice_no , esl.shipping_list_no , eiim.customer_product_code_number , eiim.extra_invoice_no , eiim.extra_packing_inspection , eiim.extra_spec , ein.invoice_name , S_REQ.NO_SALES_ORDER_SERIAL , S_REQ.NO_SALES_ORDER_VAL
-- [두 번째 쿼리: 출하요청 정보 - 원본 유지 및 프로세스 수량 추가] , L.STS_PROGRESS AS STS_PROGRESS_LOT , S_REQ.QTY_SALES_REQUEST , S_REQ.QTY_WH_STOCK , S_REQ.QTY_PROCESS , S_REQ.QTY_REFERENCE , S_REQ.NM_PARTNER , S_REQ.NM_SALES_MAN , S_REQ.NO_SALES_ORDER , S_REQ.NO_SALES_REQUEST , S_REQ.TXT_REMARK AS REQ_REMARK , S_REQ.NO_SALES_REQUEST_SERIAL , S_REQ.SEQ_SALES_REQUEST , S_REQ.QTY_SALES_REQUEST -- 중복 포함 , S_REQ.NO_SALES_ORDER -- 중복 포함 , S_REQ.NO_SALES_REQUEST -- 중복 포함 , S_REQ.NM_PARTNER -- 중복 포함 , S_REQ.NM_SALES_MAN -- 중복 포함 , S_REQ.TXT_REMARK AS REQ_REMARK -- 중복 포함 , S_REQ.TP_SALES , S_REQ.CD_MFG_UNIT , S_REQ.QTY_WH_STOCK -- 중복 포함 , S_REQ.QTY_PROCESS -- 중복 포함 , S_REQ.QTY_REFERENCE -- 중복 포함 , L.STS_PROGRESS AS STS_PROGRESS_LOT -- 중복 포함 , S_REQ.QTY_PROCESS -- 중복 포함 , S_REQ.QTY_GOOD_PROCESS -- 새로 합친 양품 수량 , S_REQ.QTY_BAD_PROCESS -- 새로 합친 불량 수량 , S_REQ.CD_PARTNER
FROM M_WO_LABEL_DETAIL A WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN I_WH_ONHAND_INVENTORY B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.CD_ITEM = B.CD_ITEM AND A.LBL_LOT_NO = B.NO_LOT INNER JOIN B_ITEM C WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.CD_ITEM = C.CD_ITEM INNER JOIN ez_invoice_inventory_mapping eiim ON eiim.lot_no = A.LBL_LOT_NO INNER JOIN ez_invoice_name ein ON eiim.invoice_no = ein.invoice_no INNER JOIN ez_inventory_lot_ext AS eile ON A.LBL_LOT_NO = eile.ext_lot_no LEFT JOIN ez_shipping_list AS esl ON A.LBL_LOT_NO = esl.lbl_lot_no
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOT_NO ORDER BY DT_UPDATE DESC) AS RN FROM S_SALES_REQUEST_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) ) L ON A.LBL_LOT_NO = L.LOT_NO AND L.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SD.NO_SALES_REQUEST_SERIAL , SD.SEQ_SALES_REQUEST , SD.QTY_SALES_REQUEST , SD.NO_SALES_ORDER , SR.NO_SALES_REQUEST , SO.NO_SALES_ORDER_SERIAL , SO.NO_SALES_ORDER AS NO_SALES_ORDER_VAL , P.NM_PARTNER , U.NM_BIZ_USER AS NM_SALES_MAN , SD.TXT_REMARK , SD.TP_SALES , SG.CD_MFG_UNIT , P.CD_PARTNER , CAST(DBO.WISEN_IN_STOCK_Q('A','*', '', SD.CD_ITEM, 'G', '') AS NUMERIC(18,6)) AS QTY_WH_STOCK , ISNULL(PROC_SUM.QTY_PROCESS, 0) AS QTY_PROCESS , ISNULL(PROC_SUM.QTY_GOOD_PROCESS, 0) AS QTY_GOOD_PROCESS , ISNULL(PROC_SUM.QTY_BAD_PROCESS, 0) AS QTY_BAD_PROCESS , (FLOOR(SD.QTY_STOCK_UNIT + (SD.QTY_STOCK_UNIT * ISNULL(SO.RATE_OVER_MAX, 0) / 100)) - ISNULL(PROC_SUM.QTY_PROCESS, 0)) AS QTY_REFERENCE FROM S_SALES_REQUEST_DETAIL SD WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN S_SALES_REQUEST SR WITH (NOLOCK) ON SR.NO_SALES_REQUEST_SERIAL = SD.NO_SALES_REQUEST_SERIAL LEFT JOIN B_PARTNER P WITH (NOLOCK) ON P.CD_PARTNER = SD.CD_TRANS_PARTNER LEFT JOIN B_BIZ_USER U WITH (NOLOCK) ON U.CD_BIZ_USER = SR.CD_SALES_MAN LEFT JOIN B_SALES_GROUP SG WITH (NOLOCK) ON SG.CD_SALES_GROUP = SR.CD_SALES_GROUP LEFT JOIN S_SALES_ORDER SO WITH (NOLOCK) ON SO.NO_SALES_ORDER_SERIAL = SD.NO_SALES_ORDER_SERIAL -- [프로세스 집계 조인] LEFT JOIN ( SELECT NO_SALES_REQUEST_SERIAL, SEQ_SALES_REQUEST , SUM(QTY_PROCESS) AS QTY_PROCESS , SUM(QTY_GOOD_PROCESS) AS QTY_GOOD_PROCESS , SUM(QTY_BAD_PROCESS) AS QTY_BAD_PROCESS FROM S_SALES_REQUEST_PROCESS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE FG_PROCESS = 'P' AND TP_PROCESS = 'INSAI' AND FG_MODULE = 'IN' GROUP BY NO_SALES_REQUEST_SERIAL, SEQ_SALES_REQUEST ) PROC_SUM ON PROC_SUM.NO_SALES_REQUEST_SERIAL = SD.NO_SALES_REQUEST_SERIAL AND PROC_SUM.SEQ_SALES_REQUEST = SD.SEQ_SALES_REQUEST ) S_REQ ON L.NO_SALES_REQUEST_SERIAL = S_REQ.NO_SALES_REQUEST_SERIAL AND L.SEQ_SALES_REQUEST = S_REQ.SEQ_SALES_REQUEST
LEFT JOIN S_SALES_TYPE ST WITH (NOLOCK) ON ST.TP_SALES = S_REQ.TP_SALES
WHERE 1=1 AND B.QTY_INVENTORY != 0 AND B.CD_WH = 'YC_FG3' AND eiim.invoice_no = #{invoice_no} AND (ST.YN_TRANSACTION IS NULL OR ST.YN_TRANSACTION = 'Y') AND (S_REQ.CD_MFG_UNIT IN (SELECT X.CD_MFG_UNIT FROM B_PARTY_USER X, B_BIZ_USER Y WHERE X.CD_BIZ_USER = Y.CD_BIZ_USER) OR ISNULL(S_REQ.CD_MFG_UNIT, '') = '') AND esl.shipping_list_no IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY A.DT_UPDATE DESC

SELECT ISNULL(SUM(QTY_PROCESS),0) AS QTY_PROCESS ,ISNULL(SUM(QTY_GOOD_PROCESS),0) AS QTY_GOOD_PROCESS ,ISNULL(SUM(QTY_BAD_PROCESS),0) AS QTY_BAD_PROCESS FROM S_SALES_REQUEST_PROCESS WHERE NO_SALES_REQUEST_SERIAL = #{no_sales_request_serial} AND SEQ_SALES_REQUEST = #{seq_sales_request} AND FG_PROCESS = 'P'

SELECT TOP 1 eiim.lot_no AS lbl_lot_no , eiim.invoice_no FROM ez_invoice_inventory_mapping eiim INNER JOIN M_WO_LABEL_DETAIL A WITH (NOLOCK) ON eiim.lot_no = A.LBL_LOT_NO INNER JOIN I_WH_ONHAND_INVENTORY B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.CD_ITEM = B.CD_ITEM AND A.LBL_LOT_NO = B.NO_LOT LEFT JOIN ez_shipping_list esl ON eiim.lot_no = esl.lbl_lot_no WHERE eiim.invoice_no = #{invoice_no} AND A.NO_MFG_ORDER_SERIAL = #{no_mfg_order_serial} AND FLOOR(B.QTY_INVENTORY) = #{qty_inventory} AND B.QTY_INVENTORY != 0 AND B.CD_WH = 'YC_FG3' AND (esl.shipping_list_no IS NULL OR esl.shipping_list_no = '') -- 미출력 조건 ORDER BY eiim.lot_no ASC
